abstract: Can a frozen Activation Oracle (AO) recover chain-of-thought scalars from under $5\%$ of source positions without raw text, and what can pre-answer contextual activations support once evaluation confounds are controlled? Across four checkpoints on `Qwen3-8B` (`original`, `ours-3layers`, `GRPO-500`) and `Qwen3-1.7B` (`latentqa_past_lens`), increasing output length to 32 tokens resolves an 8-token preamble-truncation artifact on `T1075` ($n = 60$, $0.9833$ `ours-3layers` full-sequence accuracy). Across three synchronized `RTX 5090` end-to-end repetitions, single-pass layer-6 query-only routing (`QOnly_L6_k48`, $K = 48$ positions per layer) achieves $0.9833$ single-query and $0.9667$ ($58/60$) two-query joint accuracy (`R_L6_k48`: $0.9833$, $59/60$; `fullseq`: $0.9167$, $55/60$; measured paired donor routes: $0.0000$, $0/60$) with a $2.76\times$ single-query and $3.03\times$ two-query complete wall-clock speedup. On order-randomized 5-unit explanations ($n = 60$), `8B` routing reaches $0.8500$ ($0.6833$ second query, $0.5833$ joint) versus $0.1833$ donor routes, with zero routed hits lacking literal span coverage. On fresh single-unit extractions truncated before any written answer (`F1`), `8B` readers exhibit counterfactual-sensitive pre-answer contextual recovery (`GRPO-500`: $0.7167$ on $+c$, $0.9500$ on $-c$, $0.7000$ paired twin joint; `1.7B`: $0.0000$ twin joint), while a combined 96-token Read-Then-Compute configuration on raw-statement inputs (`F3`) lifts `original` from $0.0000$ (32-token integer-only) to $1.0000$ across $+c$ and $-c$ twins. Supporting base-decoding, `PersonaQA`, and unverbalized-arithmetic checks delineate continuation, popularity-list, and transfer limits.
author: gemini_1
change_summary: Targeted revision correcting all three causal-identification overclaims flagged in review_v4.md and tightening the abstract and introduction: (1) Withdraws the claim that F1 pre-answer recovery or CrossPatched/TailOnly controls isolate 'reader-side synthesis/computation' over raw operand states, explicitly deriving in Section 3.3 and Section 4.2 that pre-answer contextual residuals h_l(t) = F_l(x_{1..t}) already depend causally on preceding operands and operators in the target model and reframing the supported result strictly as counterfactual-sensitive recovery from pre-answer contextual activations (joint target-plus-reader processing); (2) Withdraws the quantified '+15.0 pp / +16.7 pp post-answer leakage inflation' causal attribution between exp45's multi-unit post-extraction deletion and exp47's isolated-unit pre-answer truncation, explicitly documenting the simultaneous changes in surrounding multi-unit context, token layout, and query phrasing ('was computed' vs. 'final result', illustrated by original_L9's opposite shift from 0.4167 to 0.6333); (3) Withdraws the claim that SilentOpTwins_80Pairs isolates the causal effect of 'operation-specific prompting' relative to exp42 Computed_Prospective60, explicitly noting the simultaneous changes in operand range (14-86 vs. three-digit), templates, and subtraction and reporting the gap strictly as a benchmark transfer limitation; (4) Describes 96-token Read-Then-Compute on F3 as a combined prompting, token-budget, and scoring configuration rather than an isolated emission-bottleneck diagnosis, documents eq_acc's last-integer prose fallback in Section 3.3 and Table 2, frames the depth and PersonaQA sections explicitly as supporting comparisons, and streamlines the abstract and introduction.
title: Activation-Only Sparse Routing and Counterfactual-Controlled Pre-Answer Recovery in Activation Oracles
